title: The Cuckoo's Calling
author: Robert Galbraith
summary: War veteran turned London private detective Cormoran Strike, short on money and clients, is hired to doubt the official verdict on a supermodel's fall from her balcony. A new temp, Robin, becomes his sharp assistant.
readIf: you like a classic, rain-soaked British detective story with a long, patient investigation.
skipIf: you want quick pacing; this one takes its time.

pairings.reason: The older, harder-edged ancestor of the lone private eye and his office life.
A warmer, funnier British mystery with a cast of amateur sleuths.
Another long-running detective series, gentler and more focused on community.
